verdict.rationale: The evidence only contains a generic claim of a 'rich ecosystem' (vue-docs-2) and official first-party libraries (Router, Pinia) but no specific mention of third-party pre-built UI component libraries (e.g., Vuetify, Element Plus, Quasar, PrimeVue). Missing for 10: named third-party UI component libraries, evidence of their adoption/maturity, and independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth for UI components specifically.
